title: Analysis of Visual Function and Morphology in Diseases and Postoperative Conditions of the Anterior Segment of the Eye
summary: This study investigates changes in vision and eye structure in patients with diseases or previous surgery affecting the front part of the eye. Data from routine eye examinations are analyzed to better understand disease progression, treatment outcomes, and the reliability of examination methods. No additional examinations or treatments are performed.
conditions: The anterior segment diseases to be investigated include: keratoconus, corneal dystrophies, corneal degenerations, keratitis, keratoconjunctivitis sicca, neurotrophic keratopathy, pterygium, corneal astigmatism, presbyopia, cataract, anterior segment injuries, and anterior uveitis.  The anterior segment surgical procedures to be investigated include: corneal collagen cross-linking, corneal transplantation, implantation of intrastromal corneal segments, cataract surgery or refractive lens exchange, implantation of supplementary intraocular lenses, superficial keratectomy, amniotic membrane transplantation, therapeutic and refractive corneal laser procedures, and pterygium excision.

interventions.name: Retrospective and prospective observational study of patients with anterior segment diseases or postoperative conditions. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Presentation at the Department of Ophthalmology, University Hospital Carl Gustav Carus Dresden, during a routine clinical visit.
2. Diagnosis or suspected diagnosis of an anterior segment disorder or previous anterior segment surgery.
3. Availability, willingness, and sufficient cognitive ability to comply with the examinations.
4. Sufficient proficiency in German to understand the study procedures and provide informed consent.
5. Written informed consent to participate in the study.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Age below 18 years.
2. Dementia or impaired legal capacity.
3. Ocular or systemic comorbidities preventing reliable diagnostic examinations.
